release_notes: - Meeting end detection via CoreAudio (kAudioDevicePropertyDeviceIsRunningSomewhere). - Recording proposed on manual Turn On and physical device activation. - Recording stops on manual Turn Off, timer expired, and physical device OFF. - Config reload no longer kills active recordings (session ID check). - Back-to-back meetings: previous recording stops when new meeting detected. - Meeting Notes v2: search, platform filter, pagination, export to Markdown, delete confirmation. - Post-reload safety net respects active recordings. - NativeTextField borderless mode for search fields.
